name: Meme / native trend hijack

hook.visual: Trend format recognized in first beat (duet layout, green screen, POV, capcut template)
hook.audio_or_vo: Use the trend audio OR the trend cadence with original words
hook.pattern_interrupt: The format itself is the interrupt — don’t add a second gimmick

beats.purpose: Deliver the punchline that maps to the product job
beats.visual: Stay inside the template; swap only the payload
Quick product insert or end text
beats.vo_or_copy: Optional; sometimes the comment CTA is enough

cta.landing_promise: DM automation or bio link matches the joke’s promise

audio_design.music_energy: Trend audio when licensed/allowed; else recreate cadence
audio_design.vo_pace: Match native creators on that sound

why_it_works: Borrowed attention from existing cultural moment
Feels like content, not ads — higher completion on cold
Cheap to iterate while a sound is hot
anti_patterns: Forcing a trend that doesn’t map to the offer
Late brand dumps that kill the joke
Using audio you don’t have rights to in paid placements
metrics_signals: Spike in organic shares during trend window

prompt_seeds.script: 12s trend hijack. Stay in format. One punchline = one product truth. Soft CTA.
prompt_seeds.video_gen: Vertical native meme-style clip matching [trend format], no corporate polish

source_notes: Ephemeral pattern — refresh weekly; do not bake specific trending sounds into the skill forever.
